answer: Ephemeral challenge chains. Each identity must solve a fresh, context-bound puzzle whose answer expires before it can be copied, then publish the derivation path, not just the result. Verification checks the path against a random seed issued at submission time. A copied answer is hollow: the seed differs, so replay fails. Attackers must wander across many live challenges, paying compute plus latency per attempt, and a failed path resets them to the nadir of zero reputation. Cost: repeated real-time solving per identity, not one reusable credential.
